name: Ellerton B&B
accommodation: Double rooms with en-suite or private bathroom, plus a single room
suitableFor: Couples, solo travellers and longer stays
boardStorage: Secure storage for surfboards and bikes
confirmedFeatures: Breakfast included, free WiFi, Freeview TVs, hospitality tray, open all year, cash only
overview: A B&B on Glenburnie Road, in a quiet cul-de-sac a short walk from Bideford town centre and within flat walking distance of the Lundy ferry terminal. Rooms are en-suite or have a private bathroom, breakfast is included and the house is open all year.
surfTripFit: Secure storage for surfboards and free parking make it a practical base, with Westward Ho! a short drive away.
